title: 第940章 双修第939章 恢复
lines: 长离未央将脸埋在叶无缺的胸膛，泪水如同断了线的珍珠，打湿了叶无缺的衣襟。
数百年来的担忧、恐惧、执着、思念，在这一刻尽数爆发出来。
叶无缺感受着怀中人儿的颤抖与温热，眸子中浮现出浓浓的感动和心疼之色。
他伸出手，轻轻环住长离未央的腰，将她紧紧拥入怀中。
自己这一次假死之后，长离未央竟然将整个无归时空海都找遍了……只为找到自己！
这极有可能是一场没有任何希望、没有任何尽头的找寻，可长离未央却就是没有放弃，一直找了下去。
今日，终于成功找到了……
“傻瓜。”
叶无缺轻轻抚摸着她的红发，声音温柔得能滴出水来：
“让你受委屈了。”
“对不起，又让你担心了……”
长离未央轻摇螓首，从他怀里抬起头，泪眼婆娑地看着他，哽咽道：
“只要找到你了，一切都值得了……”
“我就知道，你不会那么容易死的。”
“你答应过我的，要陪我看遍诸天星海，走遍万古轮回……”
叶无缺看着她梨花带雨的模样，心中一软，伸手轻轻拭去她脸上的泪水。
叶无缺深吸一口气，声音带着一丝不易察觉的沙哑：
“对不起，让你久等了。”
“荒仙纪元的事情，我全部都想起来了……”
“在荒仙纪元，你为了守护我，挡下了超脱者的恐怖一击……”
“现在我全部想起来了……”
长离未央闻言，泪水流得更凶了。
不过这一次，是高兴的泪水。
他记起来了。
他终于全部记起来了。
“太好了……呜……”
长离未央喜极而泣，刚想说什么，却发不出声音了。
因为叶无缺微微俯身，直接吻住了长离未央的红唇。
这一吻，很霸道，很深入。
带着失而复得的珍视，带着跨越纪元的思念。
长离未央愣了一下，随即闭上双眼，热情地回应着叶无缺。
两人拥吻在了一起。
周围的时空乱流仿佛都为之静止，四大圣法本源散发出柔和的光芒，静静环绕在两人周围。
这个吻，她已经等待了太久太久……
从荒仙纪元的别离，到这一纪元的重逢。
无尽岁月的等待与寻觅，终于在这一刻，得到了圆满。
良久，唇分。
长离未央俏脸通红，依偎在叶无缺的怀里，呼吸微微急促。
content_en:
Changli Weiyang buried her face in Ye Wuque's chest, her tears wet Ye Wuque's clothes like broken pearls.
Hundreds of years of worry, fear, persistence, and longing all burst out at this moment.
Ye Wuque felt the trembling and warmth of the person in his arms, and his eyes showed deep emotion and distress.
He stretched out his hand, gently wrapped his arms around Chang Li Weiyang's waist, and held her tightly in his arms.
After she faked her death this time, Changli Weiyang actually searched the entire space and sea of ​​No Return... just to find herself!
This was most likely a search without any hope and without any end, but Changli Weiyang did not give up and kept searching.
Today, I finally found it successfully...
"Fool."
Ye Wuque gently stroked her red hair, and his voice was so gentle that it could make water drop:
"You have been wronged."
"I'm sorry for making you worry again..."
Changli Weiyang shook her head slightly, raised her head from his arms, looked at him with tearful eyes, and choked with sobs:
"As long as I find you, everything will be worth it..."
"I knew you wouldn't die so easily."
"You promised me that you would accompany me to see the sky and the sea of stars, and to travel through the eternity of reincarnation..."
Ye Wuque looked at her pear blossoms with rain, and his heart softened, and he stretched out his hand to gently wipe away the tears on her face.
"Weiyang..."
Ye Wuque took a deep breath, and his voice was slightly hoarse:
"Sorry for keeping you waiting."
"I have remembered everything about the Desolate Immortal Era..."
"In the Era of the Immortals, in order to protect me, you blocked the terrifying blow of the Transcendent One..."
"Now I remember it all..."
When Changli Weiyang heard this, her tears flowed even more fiercely.
But this time, it was tears of joy.
He remembered.
He finally remembered it all.
"That's great...woo..."
Changli Weiyang cried with joy. She wanted to say something, but she couldn't make any sound.
Because Ye Wuque leaned forward slightly and kissed Chang Li Weiyang's red lips directly.
This kiss was very domineering and deep.
With the treasure that is lost and found, with the longing that spans the ages.
Changli Weiyang was stunned for a moment, then closed her eyes and responded to Ye Wuque enthusiastically.
The two hugged each other.
The turbulence of time and space around them seemed to be still, and the four sources of holy law emitted a soft light, quietly surrounding the two of them.
She has been waiting for this kiss for too long...
From the separation in the Desolate Immortal Era to the reunion in this era.
Endless years of waiting and searching finally came to fruition at this moment.
After a long time, the lips parted.
Changli Weiyang's pretty face turned red, and she snuggled into Ye Wuque's arms, breathing slightly.
